title: ProveChecksResponse
description: Proof's answer, filtered against the kept tests of the slices named, and the solo proofs to run because the checks failed; or that proof was not asked.

alone.description: No solo proof runs when proof was not asked.
The solo proofs to run, the request's whenFailed when a checks item failed, and none otherwise.

setting.description: settings.forge.tryExamples when the examples were tried: must when it is left out.

head.description: The commit the examples were tried on.

carried.description: Whether the slice's request carried any of the design's examples.

results.description: Each example of the slice's actions, in the design's order, with what came back: as designed, refused by its request schema, otherwise with both sides, not known or not tried with the reason. The built mode's words are kept from it when they quote a kept test beyond the design's examples.

items.description: What the built mode answered to the design's worked examples, each tried in a throwaway copy of the head of its own.

tried.description: For each slice of the wave, what the built mode answered to the design's worked examples on the combined head; empty for a solo proof.
